Predict from a Tensor Regression Fit

Source: R/spgtr.R
predict.spgtr.Rd

Predict from a Tensor Regression Fit

Usage

# S3 method for class 'spgtr'
predict(
  object,
  newX = NULL,
  newZ = NULL,
  type = c("response", "link", "class"),
  ...
)

Arguments

object

A fit from spgtr() or spgtr_cv().

newX

New subjects, in either form accepted by spgtr(). If omitted, predictions for the subjects used in fitting are returned.

newZ

New ordinary covariates, required when the fit used Z.

type

"response" (default) for the outcome scale – a probability for binomial(), an expected count for poisson(); "link" for the linear predictor; "class" for a 0/1 label thresholded at 0.5 (binomial fits only).

...

Unused.

Value

A numeric vector with one prediction per subject.

Examples

set.seed(3)
X <- lapply(1:80, function(i) matrix(rnorm(20), 5, 4))
y <- rbinom(80, 1, 0.5)
fit <- spgtr(X, y, u = c(1, 1))
predict(fit, X[1:5], type = "response")
#> [1] 0.6807172 0.3221624 0.6238999 0.6248340 0.3706757
